title: Sea life
caption: Each depth has its own quiet ambient movement
intro: Fish sway in Sunlit, jellies bob in Twilight, a whale glides in Midnight and bubbles rise in Abyss. Compare a second fish school, then inspect the still seabed and shafts of light.
contract: Import creatures from slide-shared/iceberg/scenery/sea-life and Seabed or LightRays from scenery/seabed. Counts and seeds give reproducible groups; explicit placements override them. ZoneScene composes these parts for story Slides. Ambient loops stop outside the active Slide and with reduced motion.
